items.title: Meshy wants AI for 3D creation to feel less like a prompt and more like a creative partner
items.excerpt: Meshy's conversational 3D Agent keeps context across a chat so artists can brainstorm, iterate, and batch-build style-consistent asset families before exporting production-ready, riggable models into existing pipelines.

items.title: Twitch streamer Ludwig appears as an NPC in a Chinese FMV game — stuffed with AI slop
items.excerpt: The live-action FMV game Road To Empress II casts streamer Ludwig as an NPC but leans on generative-AI slop for much of its visuals — a concrete case of how gen-AI is folded into shipped titles and how players react.

items.title: Desperate for Duskbloods news? AI chatbots will just make it up
items.excerpt: AI chatbots confidently present fabricated Reddit posts as fact about FromSoftware's unreleased Switch 2 game The Duskbloods — a look at how generative-AI hallucination reshapes how players source game information.
